claims.statement: Does there exist one family of single-valued law-valued sections S_X : M(X) -> J(X), for every finite nonempty typed list X, with m_X after S_X equal to the identity, that is natural under every coordinatewise finite Markov kernel and every admitted marginal-compatible arity-changing presentation kernel including correlation-generating split refinements, is faithful to every admitted positive full joint law, and through the marginal datum independently recovers the full-joint VFE of every compatible recognition/generative/evidence triple, the pulled-back full-joint Fisher tensor of every compatible positive C^1 statistical family, and the typed intervention semantics of every compatible enriched intervention structure?
claims.quantifiers: There exists a single family (S_X)_X, one section for each finite nonempty typed list X, such that for every coordinatewise finite Markov kernel, every admitted marginal-compatible arity-changing presentation kernel including every admitted correlation-generating split refinement, every admitted positive joint law Q, every compatible full-joint VFE enrichment (Q,P,z), every pair of compatible positive C^1 full-joint statistical families on a common parameter space, and every pair of compatible enriched typed intervention presentations with the same marginal datum, all section, naturality, faithfulness, VFE-factorization, Fisher-factorization, and typed-intervention reconstruction requirements in the target statement hold simultaneously.
claims.falsifier: A scope-matched NONEXISTENCE_PROOF that no single family of sections satisfies every conjunct under the frozen internal universal quantifiers.
